jobs.title: Environmental Compliance Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive
. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery
and minimally invasive care
, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system
and Ion
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare
, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Primary Function of the Position

Responsibilities include supporting Intuitive’s Environmental Management System with delivery and execution of related projects including the administration and maturity of Restricted/Regulated Substance Database, Battery and Packaging program management, collaboration tools and development of operational reports and tools for use by the broader functional and regional teams. This role is intended to help Intuitive demonstrate compliance to its Environmental and Social Responsibility competencies.

Role & Responsibilities

To accomplish this role, you will have the following responsibilities:

Partner cross functionally with regional regulatory teams as well as Product Operations teams to develop and design programs in accordance with various regulatory requirements
Effectively manages the execution of the Regulated Materials process ensuring compliance to identified regulations/directives
Ensure products and parts are scoped appropriately
Partner cross functionally within the organization to drive conformance and compliance
Ensure the right support is given from/to other departments to accomplish the goals
Ensuring process compliance to applicable regulations, directives, and standards (e.g. PPWR, Batteries, WEEE, etc…)
Drive maturity of Extended Producer Responsibility Process
Continuously monitor compliance to applicable regulations/directives
In partnership with cross functional teams, define strategies to mitigate compliance issues.
Support business functions in creating a defensible, documented compliance package
Additional tasks may be assigned as needed

Qualifications

Experience

Minimum 5 years relevant experience
Data management, database creation, or data and information modeling
Deep understanding of product compliance regulations in regulated industry required
Ability to manage multiple objectives and priorities concurrently
Familiarity with key business applications such as SAP and Agile PLM
Exceptional knowledge of global Environmental Compliance Directives, Regulations and Standards including but not limited to: EU RoHS, Packaging, Battery, WEEE, REACH, Prop 65 and Conflict Minerals.
Experience analyzing compliance data to verify accuracy
Product, supply chain, and design control in a medical device manufacturer (such as BOM, COTS, Custom, ASL, AML, etc…)
Translating regulatory documents to extrapolate business requirements and or product requirements

Skills

In order to adequately perform the responsibilities of this position the individual must possess or demonstrate:

Exceptional organizational, data entry, decision making and analytical skills.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Cross functional teamwork across all levels of the organization
Demonstrated self-starting, results driven, high energy level and ability to focus
Self-motivated and resourceful
Ability to manage multiple objectives and priorities concurrently
Excellent analytical skills, organizational skills, and verbal and written communication skills
Understands process flows and can think critically to develop options and recommendations
Proactive thinking and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Proven ability to communicate and collaborate with suppliers.
Strong collaborative, organizational and project management skills

Education

B.S. or higher in, Business Administration, Engineering, Regulatory Compliance, Chemistry, or equivalent work experience required.
Advanced degree preferred or equivalent experience

Additional Information

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR

743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on

business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

Candidate’s Qualifications, Consistent With Applicable Law.

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target compensation ranges are listed.

Base Salary Range Region 1:
$121,400 - $174,600

Base Salary Range Region 2:
$103,200 - $148,400

Day

Workplace Type:
Set Schedule - This job will be onsite weekly, the percentage of onsite work will be defined by the leader.

jobs.title: Graduate Environmental Scientist- 2027
jobs.description:
At Mott MacDonald, we believe engineering is about more than solving problems; it is about shaping a future that is inclusive, resilient, and sustainable. As we expand across the US and Canada, we are inviting passionate individuals to join a purpose-driven journey powered by brilliant people. As trusted consultants, we partner with clients to solve complex challenges, deliver sustainable solutions, and create lasting impact for the communities they serve.

From the moment you join our team, you will work alongside experienced engineering consultants, project managers, subject matter experts, mentors, and peers who champion integrity, teamwork, excellence, and innovation. You will build your technical skills while developing the mindset of a consultant; contributing to meaningful work, collaborating to achieve better outcomes, and growing with support every step of the way.

As a participant in Blueprint, our new graduate program, you will embark on a structured three-year development journey designed in collaboration with an award-winning learning provider. The program combines immersive learning experiences with required development sessions to build the professional, commercial, and personal effectiveness skills graduates need to thrive and lead in our business.

Your responsibilities may include:
Designing engineering solutions
Conducting and monitoring site inspections
Joining project and client meetings
Refining technical designs and documentation
Analyzing reports and specifications
Exploring project and client management
Leveraging digital tools and innovation
Driving sustainable outcomes
Building connections through our Early Career Professionals Network

To be considered for this 2027 opportunity, here’s what you’ll need:
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Environmental Science, or related field
Preferred: successful completion of EIT exam, or ability to take EIT exam within 12 months
Demonstrated interest in your chosen field through previous internships, volunteering opportunities, or organization memberships
Creative thinking skills, with a methodical and pragmatic approach to problem solving
Proficient communication and presentation skills to engage confidently with clients and colleagues
Resilient, solution-oriented mindset, with a focus on continuous growth and delivering value
Ability to build and maintain relationships and rapport with internal and external stakeholders
Collaborative spirit and commitment to teamwork

This position is located in Los Angeles, CA. You must be able to reliably commute to our office in this location, per our hybrid working policy.

Here’s an overview of what to expect this recruitment season:
August 2026 – Application Window Opens
November 30, 2026 – Application Window Closes
December 1, 2026 – January 31, 2027 – Interviews
February 1, 2027 – March 31, 2027 – Hiring Decisions Finalized
June 14, 2027 – Start Date

Build your career while helping shape what comes next.
At Mott MacDonald, you will be encouraged to explore your potential, share your ideas, and make meaningful contributions from the start.
Learning and development experiences that support your career goals
Dedicated mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals
Employee Resource Groups that help build connection and community
Meaningful opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow every day

Bring your curiosity, compassion, and drive to make a difference. If you are ready to join a collaborative engineering consultancy where your perspective is valued, your development is supported, and you are empowered to lead with integrity, we would love to hear from you.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US, as Mott MacDonald is unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

Benefits & Rewards

At Mott MacDonald, our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, providing them with a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and professional growth of our employees. Eligible employees have access to medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA and HSA accounts, company-paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage, and a competitive 401(k) plan with company matching. We also provide paid time off, paid holidays, caregiver leave, employee referral bonuses, professional registration and membership reimbursements, and tuition assistance to support continued learning and career development.

The expected salary for this position is $79,000 - $88,000

Individual pay is determined based on several factors such as work location, education, experience, and unique skills.

Collaboration at Our Core

At Mott MacDonald, we believe great ideas happen when we’re together. Our hybrid approach centers on an in-office culture, with most of your time spent collaborating face-to-face and a minimum of three days per week in the office. We balance flexibility with connection, so you and your manager can choose how to meet client, team, and personal commitments.

Equal opportunity is the law.

We seek to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they have the opportunity to contribute.
